description: Ministry of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government - Extending the retirement age of Government Registered Medical Officers to 63 Years
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Minutes on Pensions to change the compulsory retirement age for Government Registered Medical Officers. It deals specifically with public service retirement benefits and pension regulations, which falls under the category of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) concerning service conditions and retirement benefits for public sector employees.
